ledger.x: 1359: Gjin Bua Shpata's Albanians hold Angelokastron and Aetolia.
1374: Angelokastron is united with Arta under Gjin Bua Shpata.
1374: the principality of Angelokastron ends in the united Despotate of Arta.

wars.name: Battle of Achelous (1359)
wars.outcome: The Albanians, Shpata among them, beat Nikephoros II Orsini and took Aetolia; Simeon Uros recognised Shpata as despot of Aetolia and Acarnania in the early 1360s.

certainty.note: Two Albanian lordships with no named border; the line with Arta is my reading.
